headings.title: The Preaching of John the Baptist
Jesus Preaches the Gospel in Galilee
The Man with an Unclean Spirit
Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who shall prepare your way;
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: the voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight—”
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: And there went out to him all the country of Judea, and all the people of Jerusalem; and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair, and had a leather belt around his waist, and ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: And he preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: I have baptized you with water; but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: And when he came up out of the water, immediately he saw the heavens opened and the Spirit descending upon him like a dove;
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: and a voice came from heaven, “You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased.”
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: The Spirit immediately drove him out into the wilderness.
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: And he was in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan; and he was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to him.
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Now after John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches the Gospel in Galilee

verses.text: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe in the gospel.”
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches the Gospel in Galilee

verses.text: And passing along by the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “Follow me and I will make you become fishers of men.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And immediately they left their nets and followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And going on a little farther, he saw James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, who were in their boat mending the nets.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And immediately he called them; and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And they went into Caperna-um; and immediately on the sabbath he entered the synagogue and taught.
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And they were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit;
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: and he cried out, “What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are, the Holy One of God.”
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!”
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching! With authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.”
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And at once his fame spread everywhere throughout all the surrounding region of Galilee.
verses.heading: The Man with an Unclean Spirit

verses.text: And immediately he left the synagogue, and entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: Now Simon’s mother-in-law lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him of her.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: And he came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and the fever left her; and she served them.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: That evening, at sundown, they brought to him all who were sick or possessed with demons.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: And the whole city was gathered together about the door.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: And he healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and he would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew him.
verses.heading: Healings at Simon’s House

verses.text: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose and went out to a lonely place, and there he prayed.
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: And Simon and those who were with him followed him,
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: and they found him and said to him, “Every one is searching for you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: And he said to them, “Let us go on to the next towns, that I may preach there also; for that is why I came out.”
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: And he went throughout all Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and casting out demons.
verses.heading: Jesus Preaches and Heals throughout Galilee

verses.text: And a leper came to him begging him, and kneeling said to him, “If you will, you can make me clean.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: Moved with pity, he stretched out his hand and touched him, and said to him, “I will; be clean.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: And immediately the leprosy left him, and he was made clean.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: And he sternly charged him, and sent him away at once,
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to any one; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, for a proof to the people.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: But he went out and began to talk freely about it, and to spread the news, so that Jesus could no longer openly enter a town, but was out in the country; and people came to him from every quarter.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: And when he returned to Caperna-um after some days, it was reported that he was at home.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer room for them, not even about the door; and he was preaching the word to them.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And they came, bringing to him a paralytic carried by four men.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And when they could not get near him because of the crowd, they removed the roof above him; and when they had made an opening, they let down the pallet on which the paralytic lay.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Child, your sins are forgiven.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: Now some of the scribes were sitting there, questioning in their hearts,
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: “Why does this man speak like this? It is blasphemy! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they questioned like this within themselves, said to them, “Why do you question like this in your hearts?
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Rise, take up your pallet and walk’?
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: But that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: “I say to you, rise, take up your pallet and go home.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And he rose, and immediately took up the pallet and went out before them all; so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: He went out again beside the sea; and all the crowd gathered about him, and he taught them.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

verses.text: And as he passed on, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, “Follow me.” And he rose and followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

verses.text: And as he sat at table in his house, many tax collectors and sinners were sitting with Jesus and his disciples; for there were many who followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

verses.text: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

verses.text: And when Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick; I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

verses.text: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting; and people came and said to him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?”
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “Can the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: The days will come, when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; if he does, the patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made.
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; if he does, the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost, and so are the skins; but new wine is for fresh skins.”
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: One sabbath he was going through the grainfields; and as they made their way his disciples began to pluck heads of grain.
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

verses.text: And the Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the sabbath?”
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

verses.text: And he said to them, “Have you never read what David did, when he was in need and was hungry, he and those who were with him:
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

verses.text: how he entered the house of God, when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful for any but the priests to eat, and also gave it to those who were with him?”
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

verses.text: And he said to them, “The sabbath was made for man, not man for the sabbath;
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

verses.text: so the Son of man is lord even of the sabbath.”
verses.heading: A Teaching about the Sabbath

headings.title: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: Again he entered the synagogue, and a man was there who had a withered hand.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: And they watched him, to see whether he would heal him on the sabbath, so that they might accuse him.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: And he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Come here.”
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: And he said to them, “Is it lawful on the sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to kill?” But they were silent.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: And he looked around at them with anger, grieved at their hardness of heart, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: The Pharisees went out, and immediately held counsel with the Herodians against him, how to destroy him.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed; also from Judea
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: and Jerusalem and Idumea and from beyond the Jordan and from about Tyre and Sidon a great multitude, hearing all that he did, came to him.
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: And he told his disciples to have a boat ready for him because of the crowd, lest they should crush him;
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: for he had healed many, so that all who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him.
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: And whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, “You are the Son of God.”
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: And he strictly ordered them not to make him known.
verses.heading: A Multitude by the Sea

verses.text: And he went up on the mountain, and called to him those whom he desired; and they came to him.
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: And he appointed twelve, to be with him, and to be sent out to preach
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: and have authority to cast out demons:
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: Simon whom he surnamed Peter;
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James, whom he surnamed Bo-anerges, that is, sons of thunder;
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananaean,
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Appoints the Twelve

verses.text: and the crowd came together again, so that they could not even eat.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And when his friends heard it, they went out to seize him, for they said, “He is beside himself.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He is possessed by Be-elzebul, and by the prince of demons he casts out the demons.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And he called them to him, and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And if a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he cannot stand, but is coming to an end.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: But no one can enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man; then indeed he may plunder his house.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: “Truly, I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they utter;
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin”—
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: for they had said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And his mother and his brethren came; and standing outside they sent to him and called him.
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: And a crowd was sitting about him; and they said to him, “Your mother and your brethren are outside, asking for you.”
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: And he replied, “Who are my mother and my brethren?”
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: And looking around on those who sat about him, he said, “Here are my mother and my brethren!
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: Whoever does the will of God is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

headings.title: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: Again he began to teach beside the sea. And a very large crowd gathered about him, so that he got into a boat and sat in it on the sea; and the whole crowd was beside the sea on the land.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: And he taught them many things in parables, and in his teaching he said to them:
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: “Listen! A sower went out to sow.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: And as he sowed, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: Other seed fell on rocky ground, where it had not much soil, and immediately it sprang up, since it had no depth of soil;
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: and when the sun rose it was scorched, and since it had no root it withered away.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: Other seed fell among thorns and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: And other seeds fell into good soil and brought forth grain, growing up and increasing and yielding thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold.”
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: And he said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.heading: The Parable of the Sower

verses.text: And when he was alone, those who were about him with the Twelve asked him concerning the parables.
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And he said to them, “To you has been given the secret of the kingdom of God, but for those outside everything is in parables;
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: so that they may indeed see but not perceive, and may indeed hear but not understand; lest they should turn again, and be forgiven.”
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And he said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand all the parables?
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: The sower sows the word.
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And these are the ones along the path, where the word is sown; when they hear, Satan immediately comes and takes away the word which is sown in them.
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And these in like manner are the ones sown upon rocky ground, who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy;
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: and they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution arises on account of the word, immediately they fall away.
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And others are the ones sown among thorns; they are those who hear the word,
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: but the cares of the world, and the delight in riches, and the desire for other things, enter in and choke the word, and it proves unfruitful.
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: But those that were sown upon the good soil are the ones who hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold.”
verses.heading: Explanation of the Parable

verses.text: And he said to them, “Is a lamp brought in to be put under a bushel, or under a bed, and not on a stand?
verses.heading: A Lamp Is Not Hidden

verses.text: For there is nothing hidden, except to be made manifest; nor is anything secret, except to come to light.
verses.heading: A Lamp Is Not Hidden

verses.text: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.heading: A Lamp Is Not Hidden

verses.text: And he said to them, “Take heed what you hear; the measure you give will be the measure you get, and still more will be given you.
verses.heading: A Lamp Is Not Hidden

verses.text: For to him who has will more be given; and from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.”
verses.heading: A Lamp Is Not Hidden

verses.text: And he said, “The kingdom of God is as if a man should scatter seed upon the ground,
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should sprout and grow, he knows not how.
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: The earth produces of itself, first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: But when the grain is ripe, at once he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: And he said, “With what can we compare the kingdom of God, or what parable shall we use for it?
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when sown upon the ground, is the smallest of all the seeds on earth;
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: yet when it is sown it grows up and becomes the greatest of all shrubs, and puts forth large branches, so that the birds of the air can make nests in its shade.”
verses.heading: A Parable about Seeds

verses.text: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it;
verses.heading: The Use of Parables

verses.text: he did not speak to them without a parable, but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
verses.heading: The Use of Parables

verses.text: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let us go across to the other side.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: And leaving the crowd, they took him with them, just as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: And a great storm of wind arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so that the boat was already filling.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: But he was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him and said to him, “Teacher, do you not care if we perish?”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: And he awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: He said to them, “Why are you afraid? Have you no faith?”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

verses.text: And they were filled with awe, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even wind and sea obey him?”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms a Storm on the Sea

headings.title: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: They came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gerasenes.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And when he had come out of the boat, there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: who lived among the tombs; and no one could bind him any more, even with a chain;
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: for he had often been bound with shackles and chains, but the chains he wrenched apart, and the shackles he broke in pieces; and no one had the strength to subdue him.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: Night and day among the tombs and on the mountains he was always crying out, and bruising himself with stones.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And when he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshiped him;
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, do not torment me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: For he had said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He replied, “My name is Legion; for we are many.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And he begged him eagerly not to send them out of the country.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: Now a great herd of swine was feeding there on the hillside;
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: and they begged him, “Send us to the swine, let us enter them.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: So he gave them leave. And the unclean spirits came out, and entered the swine; and the herd, numbering about two thousand, rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and were drowned in the sea.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: The herdsmen fled, and told it in the city and in the country. And people came to see what it was that had happened.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And they came to Jesus, and saw the demoniac sitting there, clothed and in his right mind, the man who had had the legion; and they were afraid.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And those who had seen it told what had happened to the demoniac and to the swine.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And they began to beg Jesus to depart from their neighborhood.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And as he was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed with demons begged him that he might be with him.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: But he refused, and said to him, “Go home to your friends, and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him; and all men marveled.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac

verses.text: And when Jesus had crossed again in the boat to the other side, a great crowd gathered about him; and he was beside the sea.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: Then came one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: and begged him, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and live.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And he went with him. And a great crowd followed him and thronged about him.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And there was a woman who had had a flow of blood for twelve years,
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: and who had suffered much under many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better but rather grew worse.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: She had heard the reports about Jesus, and came up behind him in the crowd and touched his garment.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: For she said, “If I touch even his garments, I shall be made well.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And immediately the hemorrhage ceased; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her disease.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And Jesus, perceiving in himself that power had gone forth from him, immediately turned about in the crowd, and said, “Who touched my garments?”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And his disciples said to him, “You see the crowd pressing around you, and yet you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And he looked around to see who had done it.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: But the woman, knowing what had been done to her, came in fear and trembling and fell down before him, and told him the whole truth.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And he said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: While he was still speaking, there came from the ruler’s house some who said, “Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: But ignoring what they said, Jesus said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Do not fear, only believe.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And he allowed no one to follow him except Peter and James and John the brother of James.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: When they came to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, he saw a tumult, and people weeping and wailing loudly.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And when he had entered, he said to them, “Why do you make a tumult and weep? The child is not dead but sleeping.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And they laughed at him. But he put them all outside, and took the child’s father and mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: Taking her by the hand he said to her, “Talitha cumi”; which means, “Little girl, I say to you, arise.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And immediately the girl got up and walked; for she was twelve years old. And immediately they were overcome with amazement.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And he strictly charged them that no one should know this, and told them to give her something to eat.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

headings.title: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth
The Death of John the Baptist
Jesus Heals the Sick in Gennesaret

verses.text: He went away from there and came to his own country; and his disciples followed him.
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: And on the sabbath he began to teach in the synagogue; and many who heard him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get all this? What is the wisdom given to him? What mighty works are wrought by his hands!
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon, and are not his sisters here with us?” And they took offense at him.
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.”
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: And he could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands upon a few sick people and healed them.
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: And he marveled because of their unbelief. And he went about among the villages teaching.
verses.heading: The Rejection of Jesus at Nazareth

verses.text: And he called to him the Twelve, and began to send them out two by two, and gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: He charged them to take nothing for their journey except a staff; no bread, no bag, no money in their belts;
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: but to wear sandals and not put on two tunics.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And he said to them, “Where you enter a house, stay there until you leave the place.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And if any place will not receive you and they refuse to hear you, when you leave, shake off the dust that is on your feet for a testimony against them.”
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: So they went out and preached that men should repent.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick and healed them.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: King Herod heard of it; for Jesus’ name had become known. Some said, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead; that is why these powers are at work in him.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: But others said, “It is Elijah.” And others said, “It is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: But when Herod heard of it he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: For Herod had sent and seized John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodi-as, his brother Philip’s wife; because he had married her.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And Herodi-as had a grudge against him, and wanted to kill him. But she could not,
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he was much perplexed; and yet he heard him gladly.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: But an opportunity came when Herod on his birthday gave a banquet for his courtiers and officers and the leading men of Galilee.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: For when Herodi-as’ daughter came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests; and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will grant it.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And he vowed to her, “Whatever you ask me, I will give you, even half of my kingdom.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And she went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” And she said, “The head of John the Baptist.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And she came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, saying, “I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter.”
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And the king was exceedingly sorry; but because of his oaths and his guests he did not want to break his word to her.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: And immediately the king sent a soldier of the guard and gave orders to bring his head. He went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: When his disciples heard of it, they came and took his body, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.heading: The Death of John the Baptist

verses.text: The apostles returned to Jesus, and told him all that they had done and taught.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And he said to them, “Come away by yourselves to a lonely place, and rest a while.” For many were coming and going, and they had no leisure even to eat.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And they went away in the boat to a lonely place by themselves.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Now many saw them going, and knew them, and they ran there on foot from all the towns, and got there ahead of them.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: As he landed he saw a great throng, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And when it grew late, his disciples came to him and said, “This is a lonely place, and the hour is now late;
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: send them away, to go into the country and villages round about and buy themselves something to eat.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” And they said to him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give it to them to eat?”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And he said to them, “How many loaves have you? Go and see.” And when they had found out, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Then he commanded them all to sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: So they sat down in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And taking the five loaves and the two fish he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and broke the loaves, and gave them to the disciples to set before the people; and he divided the two fish among them all.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And they all ate and were satisfied.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And they took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and of the fish.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, to Beth-saida, while he dismissed the crowd.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: And after he had taken leave of them, he went up on the mountain to pray.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: And when evening came, the boat was out on the sea, and he was alone on the land.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: And he saw that they were distressed in rowing, for the wind was against them. And about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea. He meant to pass by them,
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: but when they saw him walking on the sea they thought it was a ghost, and cried out;
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: for they all saw him, and were terrified. But immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take heart, it is I; have no fear.”
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: And he got into the boat with them and the wind ceased. And they were utterly astounded,
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: for they did not understand about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: And when they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Sick in Gennesaret

verses.text: And when they got out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Sick in Gennesaret

verses.text: and ran about the whole neighborhood and began to bring sick people on their pallets to any place where they heard he was.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Sick in Gennesaret

verses.text: And wherever he came, in villages, cities, or country, they laid the sick in the market places, and begged him that they might touch even the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched it were made well.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Sick in Gennesaret

verses.text: Now when the Pharisees gathered together to him, with some of the scribes, who had come from Jerusalem,
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: they saw that some of his disciples ate with hands defiled, that is, unwashed.
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, do not eat unless they wash their hands, observing the tradition of the elders;
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: and when they come from the market place, they do not eat unless they purify themselves; and there are many other traditions which they observe, the washing of cups and pots and vessels of bronze.)
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And the Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why do your disciples not live according to the tradition of the elders, but eat with hands defiled?”
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And he said to them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me;
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the precepts of men.’
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: You leave the commandment of God, and hold fast the tradition of men.”
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And he said to them, “You have a fine way of rejecting the commandment of God, in order to keep your tradition!
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’; and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him surely die’;
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: but you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, What you would have gained from me is Corban’ (that is, given to God)—
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: then you no longer permit him to do anything for his father or mother,
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: thus making void the word of God through your tradition which you hand on. And many such things you do.”
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And he called the people to him again, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand:
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: there is nothing outside a man which by going into him can defile him; but the things which come out of a man are what defile him.”
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And when he had entered the house, and left the people, his disciples asked him about the parable.
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And he said to them, “Then are you also without understanding? Do you not see that whatever goes into a man from outside cannot defile him,
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: since it enters, not his heart but his stomach, and so passes on?” (Thus he declared all foods clean.)
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And he said, “What comes out of a man is what defiles a man.
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: For from within, out of the heart of man, come evil thoughts, fornication, theft, murder, adultery,
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: coveting, wickedness, deceit, licentiousness, envy, slander, pride, foolishness.
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: All these evil things come from within, and they defile a man.”
verses.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

verses.text: And from there he arose and went away to the region of Tyre and Sidon. And he entered a house, and would not have any one know it; yet he could not be hidden.
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: But immediately a woman, whose little daughter was possessed by an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell down at his feet.
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by birth. And she begged him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: And he said to her, “Let the children first be fed, for it is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord; yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: And he said to her, “For this saying you may go your way; the demon has left your daughter.”
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: And she went home, and found the child lying in bed, and the demon gone.
verses.heading: The Syrophoenician Woman’s Faith

verses.text: Then he returned from the region of Tyre, and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, through the region of the Decapolis.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: And they brought to him a man who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech; and they begged him to lay his hand upon him.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: And taking him aside from the multitude privately, he put his fingers into his ears, and he spat and touched his tongue;
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha,” that is, “Be opened.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: And his ears were opened, his tongue was released, and he spoke plainly.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: And he charged them to tell no one; but the more he charged them, the more zealously they proclaimed it.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

verses.text: And they were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well; he even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Deaf Man

headings.title: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod
Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida
Peter’s Declaration That Jesus Is the Christ
Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: In those days, when again a great crowd had gathered, and they had nothing to eat, he called his disciples to him, and said to them,
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: “I have compassion on the crowd, because they have been with me now three days, and have nothing to eat;
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: and if I send them away hungry to their homes, they will faint on the way; and some of them have come a long way.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And his disciples answered him, “How can one feed these men with bread here in the desert?”
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And he asked them, “How many loaves have you?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And he commanded the crowd to sit down on the ground; and he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks he broke them and gave them to his disciples to set before the people; and they set them before the crowd.
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And they had a few small fish; and having blessed them, he commanded that these also should be set before them.
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And they ate, and were satisfied; and they took up the broken pieces left over, seven baskets full.
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And there were about four thousand people.
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: And he sent them away; and immediately he got into the boat with his disciples, and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
verses.heading: Feeding the Four Thousand

verses.text: The Pharisees came and began to argue with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, to test him.
verses.heading: The Demand for a Sign

verses.text: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly, I say to you, no sign shall be given to this generation.”
verses.heading: The Demand for a Sign

verses.text: And he left them, and getting into the boat again he departed to the other side.
verses.heading: The Demand for a Sign

verses.text: Now they had forgotten to bring bread; and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: And he cautioned them, saying, “Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.”
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: And they discussed it with one another, saying, “We have no bread.”
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: And being aware of it, Jesus said to them, “Why do you discuss the fact that you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive or understand? Are your hearts hardened?
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: Having eyes do you not see, and having ears do you not hear? And do you not remember?
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They said to him, “Twelve.”
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: “And the seven for the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” And they said to him, “Seven.”
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: And he said to them, “Do you not yet understand?”
verses.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

verses.text: And they came to Beth-saida. And some people brought to him a blind man, and begged him to touch him.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida

verses.text: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the village; and when he had spit on his eyes and laid his hands upon him, he asked him, “Do you see anything?”
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida

verses.text: And he looked up and said, “I see men; but they look like trees, walking.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida

verses.text: Then again he laid his hands upon his eyes; and he looked intently and was restored, and saw everything clearly.
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida

verses.text: And he sent him away to his home, saying, “Do not even enter the village.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cures a Blind Man at Beth-saida

verses.text: And Jesus went on with his disciples, to the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
verses.heading: Peter’s Declaration That Jesus Is the Christ

verses.text: And they told him, “John the Baptist; and others say, Elijah; and others one of the prophets.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Declaration That Jesus Is the Christ

verses.text: And he asked them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered him, “You are the Christ.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Declaration That Jesus Is the Christ

verses.text: And he charged them to tell no one about him.
verses.heading: Peter’s Declaration That Jesus Is the Christ

verses.text: And he began to teach them that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: And he said this plainly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: But turning and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you are not on the side of God, but of men.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: And he called to him the multitude with his disciples, and said to them, “If any man would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: For whoever would save his life will lose it; and whoever loses his life for my sake and the gospel’s will save it.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: For what can a man give in return for his life?
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: For whoever is ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of him will the Son of man also be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

artifacts: Appended leading duplicate Mark 9:1 source continuation to Mark 8:38.

headings.title: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit
Jesus Again Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: And he said to them, “Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power.”
And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James and John, and led them up a high mountain apart by themselves; and he was transfigured before them,
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: and his garments became glistening, intensely white, as no fuller on earth could bleach them.
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses; and they were talking to Jesus.
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: And Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is well that we are here; let us make three booths, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah.”
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: For he did not know what to say, for they were exceedingly afraid.
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: And a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son; listen to him.”
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: And suddenly looking around they no longer saw any one with them but Jesus only.
verses.heading: The Transfiguration

verses.text: And as they were coming down the mountain, he charged them to tell no one what they had seen, until the Son of man should have risen from the dead.
verses.heading: The Coming of Elijah

verses.text: So they kept the matter to themselves, questioning what the rising from the dead meant.
verses.heading: The Coming of Elijah

verses.text: And they asked him, “Why do the scribes say that first Elijah must come?”
verses.heading: The Coming of Elijah

verses.text: And he said to them, “Elijah does come first to restore all things; and how is it written of the Son of man, that he should suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
verses.heading: The Coming of Elijah

verses.text: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they did to him whatever they pleased, as it is written of him.”
verses.heading: The Coming of Elijah

verses.text: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great crowd about them, and scribes arguing with them.
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And immediately all the crowd, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and ran up to him and greeted him.
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And he asked them, “What are you discussing with them?”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And one of the crowd answered him, “Teacher, I brought my son to you, for he has a mute spirit;
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: and wherever it seizes him, it dashes him down; and he foams and grinds his teeth and becomes rigid; and I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they were not able.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And he answered them, “O faithless generation, how long am I to be with you? How long am I to bear with you? Bring him to me.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And they brought the boy to him; and when the spirit saw him, immediately it convulsed the boy, and he fell on the ground and rolled about, foaming at the mouth.
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And Jesus asked his father, “How long has he had this?” And he said, “From childhood.
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And it has often cast him into the fire and into the water, to destroy him; but if you can do anything, have pity on us and help us.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “If you can! All things are possible to him who believes.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: Immediately the father of the child cried out and said, “I believe; help my unbelief!”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And when Jesus saw that a crowd came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And after crying out and convulsing him terribly, it came out, and the boy was like a corpse; so that most of them said, “He is dead.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him up, and he arose.
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And when he had entered the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why could we not cast it out?”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: And he said to them, “This kind cannot be driven out by anything but prayer and fasting.”
verses.heading: The Healing of a Boy with a Mute Spirit

verses.text: They went on from there and passed through Galilee. And he would not have any one know it;
verses.heading: Jesus Again Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: for he was teaching his disciples, saying to them, “The Son of man will be delivered into the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, after three days he will rise.”
verses.heading: Jesus Again Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: But they did not understand the saying, and they were afraid to ask him.
verses.heading: Jesus Again Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: And they came to Caperna-um; and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”
verses.heading: True Greatness

verses.text: But they were silent; for on the way they had discussed with one another who was the greatest.
verses.heading: True Greatness

verses.text: And he sat down and called the Twelve and he said to them, “If any one would be first, he must be last of all and servant of all.”
verses.heading: True Greatness

verses.text: And he took a child, and put him in the midst of them; and taking him in his arms, he said to them,
verses.heading: True Greatness

verses.text: “Whoever receives one such child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, receives not me but him who sent me.”
verses.heading: True Greatness

verses.text: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw a man casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he was not following us.”
verses.heading: Another Exorcist

verses.text: But Jesus said, “Do not forbid him; for no one who does a mighty work in my name will be able soon after to speak evil of me.
verses.heading: Another Exorcist

verses.text: For he that is not against us is for us.
verses.heading: Another Exorcist

verses.text: For truly, I say to you, whoever gives you a cup of water to drink because you bear the name of Christ, will by no means lose his reward.
verses.heading: Another Exorcist

verses.text: “Whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him if a great millstone were hung round his neck and he were thrown into the sea.
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: And if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off; it is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go to hell, to the unquenchable fire.
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: And if your foot causes you to sin, cut it off; it is better for you to enter life lame than with two feet to be thrown into hell.
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out; it is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than with two eyes to be thrown into hell,
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: where their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: For every one will be salted with fire.
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

verses.text: Salt is good; but if the salt has lost its saltiness, how will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
verses.heading: Temptations to Sin

duplicateVerseBlocks.keptText: And he said to them, “Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power.”

The Request of James and John

verses.text: And he left there and went to the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan, and crowds gathered to him again; and again, as his custom was, he taught them.
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: And Pharisees came up and in order to test him asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: He answered them, “What did Moses command you?”
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: They said, “Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of divorce, and to put her away.”
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: But from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: ‘For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife,
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: and the two shall become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two but one flesh.
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: What therefore God has joined together, let not man put asunder.”
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: And in the house the disciples asked him again about this matter.
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: And he said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another, commits adultery against her;
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: and if she divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
verses.heading: Teachings about Divorce

verses.text: And they were bringing children to him, that he might touch them; and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

verses.text: But when Jesus saw it he was indignant, and said to them, “Let the children come to me, do not hinder them; for to such belongs the kingdom of God.
verses.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child shall not enter it.”
verses.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

verses.text: And he took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands upon them.
verses.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

verses.text: And as he was setting out on his journey, a man ran up and knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but God alone.
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not kill, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Do not defraud, Honor your father and mother.’”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And he said to him, “Teacher, all these I have observed from my youth.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And Jesus looking upon him loved him, and said to him, “You lack one thing; go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: At that saying his countenance fell, and he went away sorrowful; for he had great possessions.
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it will be for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And the disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God!
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And they were exceedingly astonished, and said to him, “Then who can be saved?”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: Jesus looked at them and said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God; for all things are possible with God.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: Peter began to say to him, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: Jesus said, “Truly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or lands, for my sake and for the gospel,
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: who will not receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions, and in the age to come eternal life.
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: But many that are first will be last, and the last first.”
verses.heading: The Rich Man

verses.text: And they were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was walking ahead of them; and they were amazed, and those who followed were afraid. And taking the Twelve again, he began to tell them what was to happen to him,
verses.heading: A Third Time Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: saying, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes, and they will condemn him to death, and deliver him to the Gentiles;
verses.heading: A Third Time Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: and they will mock him, and spit upon him, and scourge him, and kill him; and after three days he will rise.”
verses.heading: A Third Time Jesus Foretells His Death and Resurrection

verses.text: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came forward to him, and said to him, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask of you.”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And he said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And they said to him, “Grant us to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory.”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: But Jesus said to them, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the chalice that I drink, or to be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized?”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And they said to him, “We are able.” And Jesus said to them, “The chalice that I drink you will drink; and with the baptism with which I am baptized, you will be baptized;
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: but to sit at my right hand or at my left is not mine to grant, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And when the ten heard it, they began to be indignant at James and John.
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And Jesus called them to him and said to them, “You know that those who are supposed to rule over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great men exercise authority over them.
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: But it shall not be so among you; but whoever would be great among you must be your servant,
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: and whoever would be first among you must be slave of all.
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: For the Son of man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.heading: The Request of James and John

verses.text: And they came to Jericho; and as he was leaving Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the roadside.
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And many rebuked him, telling him to be silent; but he cried out all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” And they called the blind man, saying to him, “Take heart; rise, he is calling you.”
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And throwing off his cloak he sprang up and came to Jesus.
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “What do you want me to do for you?” And the blind man said to him, “Master, let me receive my sight.”
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “Go your way; your faith has made you well.” And immediately he received his sight and followed him on the way.
verses.heading: Bartimaeus Receives His Sight

headings.title: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: and said to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat; untie it and bring it.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: If any one says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately.’”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And they went away, and found a colt tied at the door out in the open street; and they untied it.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And those who stood there said to them, “What are you doing, untying the colt?”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And they told them what Jesus had said; and they let them go.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and threw their garments on it; and he sat upon it.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And many spread their garments on the road, and others spread leafy branches which they had cut from the fields.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And those who went before and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming! Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And he entered Jerusalem, and went into the temple; and when he had looked round at everything, as it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: On the following day, when they came from Bethany, he was hungry.
verses.heading: Jesus Curses the Fig Tree

verses.text: And seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to see if he could find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.heading: Jesus Curses the Fig Tree

verses.text: And he said to it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” And his disciples heard it.
verses.heading: Jesus Curses the Fig Tree

verses.text: And they came to Jerusalem. And he entered the temple and began to drive out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons;
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

verses.text: and he would not allow any one to carry anything through the temple.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

verses.text: And he taught, and said to them, “Is it not written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

verses.text: And the chief priests and the scribes heard it and sought a way to destroy him; for they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

verses.text: And when evening came they went out of the city.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

verses.text: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away to its roots.
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: And Peter remembered and said to him, “Master, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered.”
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: And Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will come to pass, it will be done for him.
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you receive it, and you will.
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against any one; so that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.”
verses.heading: The Lesson from the Withered Fig Tree

verses.text: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to him,
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: and they said to him, “By what authority are you doing these things, or who gave you this authority to do them?”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you a question; answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: Was the baptism of John from heaven or from men? Answer me.”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: And they argued with one another, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: But shall we say, ‘From men’?”—they were afraid of the people, for all held that John was a real prophet.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned

verses.text: So they answered Jesus, “We do not know.” And Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Authority Is Questioned
