headings.title: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants
Jesus Denounces the Hypocrisy of the Scribes

verses.text: And he began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge around it, and dug a pit for the wine press, and built a tower, and leased it to tenants, and went into another country.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: When the time came, he sent a servant to the tenants, to get from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: And they took him and beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: Again he sent to them another servant, and they wounded him in the head, and treated him shamefully.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: And he sent another, and him they killed; and so with many others, some they beat and some they killed.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: He had still one other, a beloved son; finally he sent him to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: But those tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: And they took him and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: What will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the tenants, and give the vineyard to others.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: Have you not read this Scripture: ‘The very stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: this was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: And they tried to arrest him, but feared the multitude, for they perceived that he had told the parable against them; so they left him and went away.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

verses.text: And they sent to him some of the Pharisees and some of the Herodians, to entrap him in his talk.
verses.heading: The Question about Paying Taxes

verses.text: And they came and said to him, “Teacher, we know that you are true, and care for no man; for you do not regard the position of men, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
verses.heading: The Question about Paying Taxes

verses.text: Should we pay them, or should we not?” But knowing their hypocrisy, he said to them, “Why put me to the test? Bring me a coin, and let me look at it.”
verses.heading: The Question about Paying Taxes

verses.text: And they brought one. And he said to them, “Whose likeness and inscription is this?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
verses.heading: The Question about Paying Taxes

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” And they were amazed at him.
verses.heading: The Question about Paying Taxes

verses.text: And Sadducees came to him, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him a question, saying,
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife, but leaves no child, the man must take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: There were seven brothers; the first took a wife, and when he died left no children;
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: and the second took her, and died, leaving no children; and the third likewise;
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: and the seven left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: In the resurrection whose wife will she be? For the seven had her as wife.”
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Is not this why you are wrong, that you know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: And as for the dead being raised, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: He is not God of the dead, but of the living; you are quite wrong.”
verses.heading: The Question about Man’s Resurrection

verses.text: And one of the scribes came up and heard them disputing with one another, and seeing that he answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the first of all?”
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: Jesus answered, “The first is, ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one;
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: and you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: The second is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: And the scribe said to him, “You are right, Teacher; you have truly said that he is one, and there is no other but he;
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is much more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: And when Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And after that no one dared to ask him any question.
verses.heading: The First Commandment

verses.text: And as Jesus taught in the temple, he said, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.heading: A Question about the Christ

verses.text: David himself, inspired by the Holy Spirit, declared, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand, till I put your enemies under your feet.’
verses.heading: A Question about the Christ

verses.text: David himself calls him Lord; so how is he his son?” And the great throng heard him gladly.
verses.heading: A Question about the Christ

verses.text: And in his teaching he said, “Beware of the scribes, who like to go about in long robes, and to have salutations in the market places
verses.heading: Jesus Denounces the Hypocrisy of the Scribes

verses.text: and the best seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at feasts,
verses.heading: Jesus Denounces the Hypocrisy of the Scribes

verses.text: who devour widows’ houses and for a pretense make long prayers. They will receive the greater condemnation.”
verses.heading: Jesus Denounces the Hypocrisy of the Scribes

verses.text: And he sat down opposite the treasury, and watched the multitude putting money into the treasury. Many rich people put in large sums.
verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering

verses.text: And a poor widow came, and put in two copper coins, which make a penny.
verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering

verses.text: And he called his disciples to him, and said to them, “Truly, I say to you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who are contributing to the treasury.
verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering

verses.text: For they all contributed out of their abundance; but she out of her poverty has put in everything she had, her whole living.”
verses.heading: The Widow’s Offering

verses.text: And as he came out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher, what wonderful stones and what wonderful buildings!”
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone upon another, that will not be thrown down.”
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: And as he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: “Tell us, when will this be, and what will be the sign when these things are all to be accomplished?”
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: And Jesus began to say to them, “Take heed that no one leads you astray.
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and they will lead many astray.
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: And when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed; this must take place, but the end is not yet.
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in various places, there will be famines; this is but the beginning of the sufferings.
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: “But take heed to yourselves; for they will deliver you up to councils; and you will be beaten in synagogues; and you will stand before governors and kings for my sake, to bear testimony before them.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And when they bring you to trial and deliver you up, do not be anxious beforehand about what you are to say; but say whatever is given you in that hour, for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child, and children will rise against parents and have them put to death;
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: and you will be hated by all for my name’s sake. But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: “But when you see the desolating sacrilege set up where it ought not to be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains;
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter his house, to take anything away;
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: and let him who is in the field not turn back to get a coat.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: And alas for those who are with child and for those who are nursing in those days!
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: Pray that it may not happen in winter.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: For in those days there will be such tribulation as has not been from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: And if the Lord had not shortened the days, no human being would be saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: And then if any one says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: False Christs and false prophets will arise and show signs and wonders, to lead astray, if possible, the elect.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: But take heed; I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: “But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light,
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: And then he will send out the angels, and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: “From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts forth its leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: So also, when you see these things taking place, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, this generation will not pass away before all these things take place.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: “But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Take heed, watch and pray; for you do not know when the time will come.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: It is like a man going on a journey, when he leaves home and puts his servants in charge, each with his work, and commands the doorkeeper to be on the watch.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Watch therefore—for you do not know when the master of the house will come, in the evening, or at midnight, or at cockcrow, or in the morning—
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: lest he come suddenly and find you asleep.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: And what I say to you I say to all: Watch.”
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

headings.title: The Institution of the Last Supper
The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: It was now two days before the Passover and the feast of Unleavened Bread. And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to arrest him by stealth, and kill him;
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: for they said, “Not during the feast, lest there be a tumult of the people.”
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: And while he was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at table, a woman came with an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard, very costly, and she broke the jar and poured it over his head.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: But there were some who said to themselves indignantly, “Why was the ointment thus wasted?
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: For this ointment might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor.” And they reproached her.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: But Jesus said, “Let her alone; why do you trouble her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you will, you can do good to them; but you will not always have me.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: She has done what she could; she has anointed my body beforehand for burying.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: And truly, I say to you, wherever the gospel is preached in the whole world, what she has done will be told in memory of her.”
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray him to them.
verses.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

verses.text: And when they heard it they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought an opportunity to betray him.
verses.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

verses.text: And on the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they sacrificed the Passover lamb, his disciples said to him, “Where will you have us go and prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And he sent two of his disciples, and said to them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you; follow him,
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: and wherever he enters, say to the householder, ‘The Teacher says, Where is my guest room, where I am to eat the Passover with my disciples?’
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And he will show you a large upper room furnished and ready; there prepare for us.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And the disciples set out and went to the city, and found it as he had told them; and they prepared the Passover.
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And when it was evening he came with the Twelve.
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And as they were at table eating, Jesus said, “Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me, one who is eating with me.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: They began to be sorrowful, and to say to him one after another, “Is it I?”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: He said to them, “It is one of the Twelve, one who is dipping bread in the same dish with me.
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: For the Son of man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And as they were eating, he took bread, and blessed, and broke it, and gave it to them, and said, “Take; this is my body.”
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: And he took a chalice, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, and they all drank of it.
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: And he said to them, “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, I shall not drink again of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “You will all fall away; for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you to Galilee.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Peter said to him, “Even though they all fall away, I will not.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “Truly, I say to you, this very night, before the cock crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: But he said vehemently, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” And they all said the same.
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: And they went to a place which was called Gethsemane; and he said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I pray.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he took with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly distressed and troubled.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he said to them, “My soul is very sorrowful, even to death; remain here, and watch.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And going a little farther, he fell on the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you; remove this chalice from me; yet not what I will, but what you will.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he came and found them sleeping, and he said to Peter, “Simon, are you asleep? Could you not watch one hour?
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation; the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And again he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they did not know what to answer him.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he came the third time, and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and taking your rest? It is enough; the hour has come; the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Rise, let us be going; see, my betrayer is at hand.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas came, one of the Twelve, and with him a crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, “The one I shall kiss is the man; seize him and lead him away safely.”
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And when he came, he went up to him at once, and said, “Master!” And he kissed him.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And they laid hands on him and seized him.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: But one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his ear.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs to capture me?
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Day after day I was with you in the temple teaching, and you did not seize me. But let the Scriptures be fulfilled.”
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And they all deserted him and fled.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And a young man followed him, with nothing but a linen cloth about his body; and they seized him,
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: but he left the linen cloth and ran away naked.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And they led Jesus to the high priest; and all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes were assembled.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And Peter had followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest; and he was sitting with the guards, and warming himself at the fire.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought testimony against Jesus to put him to death; but they found none.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: For many bore false witness against him, and their witness did not agree.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And some stood up and bore false witness against him, saying,
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another, not made with hands.’”
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: Yet not even so did their testimony agree.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And the high priest stood up in their midst, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer to make? What is it that these men testify against you?”
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: But he was silent and made no answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And Jesus said, “I am; and you will see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And the high priest tore his clothes, and said, “Why do we still need witnesses?
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: You have heard his blasphemy. What is your decision?” And they all condemned him as deserving death.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to strike him, saying to him, “Prophesy!” And the guards received him with blows.
verses.heading: Jesus before the Council

verses.text: And as Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the maids of the high priest came;
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, “You also were with the Nazarene, Jesus.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you mean.” And he went out into the gateway.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: And the maid saw him, and began again to say to the bystanders, “This man is one of them.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: But again he denied it. And after a little while again the bystanders said to Peter, “Certainly you are one of them; for you are a Galilean.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: But he began to invoke a curse on himself and to swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: And immediately the cock crowed a second time. And Peter remembered how Jesus had said to him, “Before the cock crows twice, you will deny me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

headings.title: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And as soon as it was morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council held a consultation; and they bound Jesus and led him away and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: And Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” And he answered him, “You have said so.”
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: And the chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: And Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer to make? See how many charges they bring against you.”
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate wondered.
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: Now at the feast he used to release for them one prisoner for whom they asked.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And among the rebels in prison, who had committed murder in the insurrection, there was a man called Barabbas.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And the crowd came up and began to ask Pilate to do as he always did for them.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And he answered them, “Do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews?”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: For he perceived that it was out of envy that the chief priests had delivered him up.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release for them Barabbas instead.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And Pilate again said to them, “Then what shall I do with the man whom you call the King of the Jews?”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And they cried out again, “Crucify him.”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they shouted all the more, “Crucify him.”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: So Pilate, wishing to satisfy the crowd, released for them Barabbas; and having scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And the soldiers led him away inside the palace (that is, the praetorium); and they called together the whole battalion.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they clothed him in a purple cloak, and plaiting a crown of thorns they put it on him.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they struck his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and they knelt down in homage to him.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And when they had mocked him, they stripped him of the purple cloak, and put his own clothes on him. And they led him out to crucify him.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they compelled a passer-by, Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to carry his cross.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And they brought him to the place called Golgotha (which means the place of a skull).
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh; but he did not take it.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And they crucified him, and divided his garments among them, casting lots for them, to decide what each should take.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And it was the third hour, when they crucified him.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And the inscription of the charge against him read, “The King of the Jews.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And with him they crucified two robbers, one on his right and one on his left.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And those who passed by derided him, shaking their heads, and saying, “Aha! You who would destroy the temple and build it in three days,
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: So also the chief priests mocked him to one another with the scribes, saying, “He saved others; he cannot save himself.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe.” Those who were crucified with him also reviled him.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, “Elo-i, Elo-i, lama sabach-thani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And some of the bystanders hearing it said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And one ran and, filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to take him down.”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And Jesus uttered a loud cry, and breathed his last.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And when the centurion, who stood facing him, saw that he thus breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: There were also women looking on from afar, among whom were Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome,
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered to him; and also many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And when evening had come, since it was the day of Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council, who was also himself looking for the kingdom of God, took courage and went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: And Pilate wondered if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he was already dead.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: And when he learned from the centurion that he was dead, he granted the body to Joseph.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: And he bought a linen shroud, and taking him down, wrapped him in the linen shroud, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of the rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was laid.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

artifacts: Verse label(s) not present in source HTML: 28.

verses.text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, so that they might go and anoint him.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And very early on the first day of the week they went to the tomb when the sun had risen.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And they were saying to one another, “Who will roll away the stone for us from the door of the tomb?”
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; for it was very large.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And he said to them, “Do not be amazed; you seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen, he is not here; see the place where they laid him.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he is going before you to Galilee; there you will see him, as he told you.”
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And they went out and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them; and they said nothing to any one, for they were afraid.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Now when he rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: But when they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they would not believe it.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: After this he appeared in another form to two of them, as they were walking into the country.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Two Disciples

verses.text: And they went back and told the rest, but they did not believe them.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Two Disciples

verses.text: Afterward he appeared to the Eleven themselves as they sat at table; and he upbraided them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: And he said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: And these signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: they will pick up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it will not hurt them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.heading: The Ascension of Jesus

verses.text: And they went forth and preached everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the message by the signs that attended it. Amen.
verses.heading: The Ascension of Jesus
